snippet: A community maintained Python library for creating mathematical animations. def construct(self): title = Tex(r"This is some \LaTeX") basel = MathTex(r"\sum_{n=1}^\infty \frac{1}{n^2} = \frac{\pi^2}{6}") VGroup(title, basel).arrange(DOWN) self.play( Write(title), FadeIn(basel, shift=DOWN), self.wait() transform_title = Tex("That was a transform")
